title: Discord accounts connect to Quests
summary:
Discord-linked Quests, web-aware agents and multi-input FFmpeg joined three community apps, while wallet checks got stricter.

Enter added Discord account linking while keeping GitHub as the sign-in provider. Connected accounts confirmed as Pollinations server members are eligible for a one-time, 1-Pollen Discord Quest. Membership is checked for the Quest rather than displayed on the account page.

The MCP catalog gained Exa tools for web search and fetching source-page content. The FFmpeg tool now accepts multiple HTTPS inputs for workflows such as combining media, and supports safe single-file output extensions beyond its former fixed list.

Descriptly uses vision models to suggest alt text for images changed in pull requests. Pollinations App lets people generate images with their own Pollen, while Dery AI offers collaborative image creation.

highlights.title: Discord joins Quests
highlights.text: Link a Discord account to your existing Pollinations account. Connected members of the Pollinations server are eligible for a one-time, 1-Pollen Quest. [Join the community](https://discord.gg/k9F7SyTgqn).

highlights.title: Multi-input FFmpeg tools
highlights.text: Give the `runFfmpeg` MCP tool multiple HTTPS sources to combine video or audio with positional `-i` inputs and multi-input filters. Outputs can use any safe single-file extension. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Exa search for agents
highlights.text: The new `/mcp/exa` endpoint gives Gen and prompt agents `web_search_exa` for web results and `web_fetch_exa` for source-page content. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
